cells.tense: You sit with what is already settled here and let the connection rest without working it.
cells.act: rest in the connection without doing anything with it
cells.ask: Pick someone you connect with easily. Sit together for the length of a song, saying nothing, and do not discuss it later.
cells.core:
You go further into a pattern than most people get to, and you do it here, where the line between your thought and what you are thinking about gets thin. That can be a relief, and it can also be a lot. There is a version of this where you stand one step away from the work and simply don't adjust anything about it.
Right now you can rest in the connection without doing anything with it. Pick someone you connect with easily, sit together for the length of a song, saying nothing, and do not discuss it later. No sentence to finish, no adjustment to make, no note afterward about how it went. The adjusting will still be there when the music ends.
cells.sheetLine: You can let a connection rest unlifted for once.
cells.verb: Going so far into the pattern that thought meets its own edge.
cells.place: Where you keep adjusting what you add and what you leave out.

cells.tense: You are pushing the next step before the present one has settled into a shape you can name.
cells.act: put the frame on the table before anyone asks
cells.ask: Before you pick up the next stretch of work, name its shape to someone you trust, and what it changes, without being asked.
cells.core:
You are already walking through a thing that has not finished being what it is. The adjustment you make for that runs in one direction, and it shows up as a correction to someone else before you have said out loud what you are actually doing. The correction arrives before the description does.
Put the frame on the table before anyone asks. Name the shape of what you are doing before they have to guess at it — not the full plan, the frame. Once it is out, the person across from you stops guessing what they are standing inside, and you stop editing a thing whose edges you kept to yourself.
cells.sheetLine: You correct what you kept the shape of.
cells.verb: Going so far into the pattern that thought meets its own edge.
cells.place: Where you keep adjusting what you add and what you leave out.

cells.tense: Where things should balance, you stay back from the moment and leave the adjustment to someone else.
cells.act: mark the good thing together, the day it happens
cells.ask: When something good lands today, say so while it is still happening, to whoever is there or to the room at large.
cells.core:
Where you adjust what you add and what you leave out, nothing gets added. The moment arrives and the room stays quiet, and you are already someplace behind it: the next task, the last one, a door you walked through and kept walking from. What is here does not get marked, and it does not get met.
Share the joy with the people it belongs to today, the day it happens. When something good lands, say so while it is still happening, to whoever is there or to the room at large. Do not save it for tonight. The gladness will do the rest of the work.
cells.sheetLine: The good moment arrives and the room stays quiet.

cells.tense: You are triaging the present from inside it, and the account of what you are doing has been filed under someone else's name.
cells.act: spend an hour with the thing you love without a task attached to it
cells.ask: Give an hour to something you love with no purpose attached, and do not explain afterward why you spent it that way.
cells.core:
The adjustment between what to add and what to leave out is happening here, and it is happening through you. You do not experience it that way. From where you sit, the day runs itself and you are along for the ride. The people nearby still feel the proportion you keep, and they have not mistaken its source once.
Spend an hour with the thing you love without a task attached to it. No purpose, no explaining afterward why the time was spent that way. The proportion you do not take credit for is already yours; the hour is where you find out how much of it is.
cells.sheetLine: The balance runs through you while you say it runs itself.
cells.verb: Going so far into the pattern that thought meets its own edge.
cells.place: Where you keep adjusting what you add and what you leave out.
